dmp.description: The project is pertinent to the ongoing debate regarding the different challenges of policy coordination during multiple crises. It aims to illuminate internal and external factors influencing decisions made by those involved in policy coordination. Thus, the proposal seeks to open new analytical pathways to study policy coordination in crises, which might be a reasonable contribution to reconceptualising policy coordination and crisis management along with digital transformation, especially in the small states.
dmp.title: Policy coordination in Latvia: challenges, instruments and actors
